name: Elizabeth Croup

residences.place: Plymouth, Luzerne Co., PA (husband James's farm, dwelling 878)
residences.note: Aged 57; son Andrew's family next door

events.title: 1860 census
events.description: Elizabeth [Pringle] 57, in household of James Pringle 61, farmer, with Edwin 18 and Mary Williams 7.

events.title: Absent from 1870 household
events.description: Her husband James, 71, was living in their son Andrew's household without her.

bioAdditions: Elizabeth was alive in August 1860, aged 57, on the family farm in Plymouth with her husband James and youngest son Edwin; her son Andrew lived next door (S1). By July 1870 James was living with Andrew and she was not in the household (S2). Either she had died in the 1860s, or she was living elsewhere - the tree's death in 1895 'IN' (Indiana?) is unsourced, but would fit her going west with relatives (her niece Mary (Shupp) Nesbitt went to Rolling Prairie, Indiana, in 1853). Her father's will is indexed as 'Croup, Frederick, Plymouth Twp., 1841, Will Book B p.80' in the Luzerne County wills index (S3); it should name her as Elizabeth Pringle.

openQuestionsResolved.question: Birth and 1895 death record; Luzerne Orphans' Court papers for Frederick Croup (d. 1841) should name her.
openQuestionsResolved.answer: Partly: Frederick Croup's will is indexed (Plymouth Twp., 1841, Luzerne Will Book B p.80) - the text is not online. Elizabeth was alive in 1860 and not in her husband's household in 1870; the 1895 death remains unsourced.

openQuestionsNew: Was she alive after 1870 (1870/1880 census elsewhere, perhaps Indiana) or did she die in the 1860s? The tree's '1895, IN' needs a source.
